summary: Iteration 10 checked the remaining fixes from iteration 9. Backend: 63 of 64 pytest tests pass. That is the full suite plus a new file, test_rf_iter10.py, with 6 tests. An all-skip solo run no longer awards first_sprint and no longer adds to 'sessions'. revise_topics only lists incorrect or timed-out cards; an all-skip run gives []. NEW REGRESSION: in gamify.award, an all-skip solo run now falls into the else-branch and adds 1 to 'duels'. UI was tested on a 375x667 viewport against the public URL. Hub chapter chips are now 44 px tall. A successful quest claim works: the button disappears and coins go from 1652 to 1682. A failed claim (mocked 409) shows nothing on web, because react-native-web's Alert.alert does nothing; native should show the Alert. Summary titles are correct: all-skip shows 'No cards answered', 5/5 shows 'Sprint complete! Loot earned', and 10/10 shows 'Blazing run! Loot unlocked'. Player confidence chips stay visible after an option is picked. BUT a confidence chosen after the answer is never sent to the server. The duel vs AI Rival ended 3-2: the human won, the AI scored lower, and live lead banners showed. The shop loads (balance 1715, avatars shown).

critical.issue: Regression: an all-skip solo run (kind='solo', played=False) skips 'if kind == "solo" and played' and lands in the final else-branch, so it adds 1 to duels and adds 0 to wins. Players can farm the duelist_10 badge with 10 all-skip runs, and profile.duels is inflated (real test user: duels=19). Reference: /app/backend/gamify.py:97-103

minor.issue: Body is an untyped dict (data: dict) instead of a Pydantic model. Reference: gamify.py:198
When the human scores 0 the AI is held at 0, so the duel ties instead of the AI scoring below. This is unavoidable, but the UI copy should handle it.

ui_bugs.issue: A failed claim (409/500) gives no feedback on the web preview, because Alert.alert from react-native-web does nothing. Native is fine. Use an inline error or toast instead, or fall back to window.alert on web. Reference: app/(tabs)/rapid.tsx:113

integration_issues.issue: Chips now stay visible after an option is picked, but tapping a chip after answering only sets local state. No PUT /answers is sent; checked by network capture, and none was sent even after Next/Prev. Confidence is only saved if it is chosen BEFORE the option. Fix: in the chip onPress, when cur.value is non-empty, call A.edit(q.id, { confidence: v }). Reference: app/attempt/[id].tsx:194

action_items: gamify.py:97-103: change the counter branch to `if kind == 'solo': if played: inc['sessions'] = 1` / `elif kind == 'bot': ...` / `else: duels/wins`, so a solo run never falls through to duels. Optionally correct inflated duels counts for affected users.
attempt/[id].tsx:194: when confidence is tapped and the question already has an answer, save it through A.edit(q.id, { confidence: v }). Hide the chips once confidence_observations has the question.
rapid.tsx:113: show the claim failure in a way that also works on web (inline Notice or toast), not only Alert.alert.
critical_code_review_comments: gamify.award: the if/elif/else counter chain does not cover kind='solo' with played=False; the gating was added to the solo condition without handling the other case.
Confidence chip state (conf) is local to the screen and only sent when an option is tapped, so the order of actions decides whether confidence is saved.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (all requested checks pass except confidence persistence; claim failure has no feedback on web)

seed_data_creation: Test profiles use TEST- uids and are cleaned up. On real user db0c62b8 (9000000001): 3 extra solo sprints (all-skip, 5/5, 10/10 Chemistry), 1 AI Rival duel (won 3-2) and 1 quest claimed (q_sprint, +30). One answer was picked and then cleared on the active Laws of Motion attempt e689d751 (Q3).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest with -n0 -p no:randomly. For solo UI tests, match the on-screen rf-card-prompt text to cards[].prompt from the POST /api/rf/sessions response; card order is not reliable by index. Answers are int indices 0-3; option testIDs are rf-option-{0..3}. Attempt via home-continue-attempt goes to /attempt/e689d751-... Use the exit sheet (rf-exit-button then rf-exit-finish) to end sessions early. Failed quest claims can be mocked with page.route on **/api/rf/quests/claim.
rca_of_issue: duels regression: gamify.py:97 `if kind == 'solo' and played` is False for an all-skip solo run, and kind != 'bot', so the else-branch (`inc['duels'] = 1`) runs. Reproduce: new uid, start a session, complete it with all cards 'skipped', then check the profile: duels == 1. Confidence: the chip onPress (line 194) calls setConf only; A.edit (which sends confidence) runs only from the option onPress (line 176).
